source: NOAA GFS 1.0 deg pressure levels + 0.25 deg orography (AWS Open Data noaa-gfs-bdp-pds); mean with ECMWF IFS open data 2026111406 (CC-BY-4.0, AWS ecmwf-forecasts), thinned to 1 deg

models.combine: boomless Mach = mean of GFS and IFS per node and direction; no corridor if either has none

disagreement.encoding: 0 no corridor in either; 1 + |IFS - GFS| / step, worst direction; 254 corridor in one model only

physics.terrain: GFS 0.25 deg orography, max over +/-0.5 deg; raised to the DEM maximum (Terrarium z8, 3x3 median) where higher

high_altitude.note: FL700-FL1000: GFS stratosphere levels to 5 hPa, dry above 50 hPa; no second model and no balloon validation yet

ssb.tiles: 6x6, direction of travel of the ray 0..350 step 10
